newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI sees 1996 net at 1.0 billion pesos.
newsitem.headline: DMCI sees 1996 net at 1.0 billion pesos.

text.p: Construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc said on Friday it expected its 1996 net income to reach one billion pesos compared with 494 million pesos in 1995.
In a disclosure to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the company said it expected 1997 net income at 1.5 billion pesos from revenues of 9.2 billion pesos.
The company said its estimated 1996 net income would exceed its forecast of 858 million pesos.
Full year revenues for 1996 are estimated to hit 6.4 billion pesos, 68.42 percent higher than the 3.5 billion pesos in 1995.
The bulk, or 76 percent, of DMCI revenues for 1996 would come from its construction activities, the company said.
The company did not say when its 1996 results would be issued but most companies are expected to announce their financial performance figures by the end of this month.
